trace.question: In which Formula_1 race did Lewis Hamilton rank the highest?
trace.evidence: rank the highest refers to min(rank); Lewis Hamilton refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;

attempts.sql:
SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM results res
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY res.rank ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM results res
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY res.rank ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: Lewis Hamilton ranked highest in the 2009 Belgian Grand Prix, according to the query result.
